explication: OpenPencil is an AI-native vector design editor centered on creating and modifying `.op` canvas documents. The principal workflow is a user prompt or selection-driven request, routed through chat-agent orchestration to a model, then applied to the editor and rendered on the canvas. Major documented branches include multi-agent work, style guides, code export, CLI/MCP access, design-system kits, and real-time collaboration. Paths for several documented subsystems are only supported at crate-directory level; the excerpts do not establish every runtime call between them.
